entries.title: I Chronicles 24:1
segments: The divisions of the sons of Aaron; these divisions, it is supposed, were made by David according to divine appointment.  By them the priests were distributed into twenty-four courses, sixteen of the sons of Eleazar, and eight of the sons of Ithamar.  These served at the sanctuary, each course in its turn, from Sabbath to Sabbath, according to the testimony of Josephus, which agrees with the words of the sacred writer,

. 
 
Order and regularity are important in all concerns, especially in those of religion; and its ministers should all, in the place which God assigns them, attend with punctuality and perseverance to the duties of their office.

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:5
segments: One sort with another; the two sorts were those of Eleazar's sons, and those of Ithamar's.

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:6
segments: One--taken for Eleazar, and one--for Ithamar; one course of the house of Eleazar was drawn, and one of the house of Ithamar alternately, till the latter house was exhausted, when the remaining eight of Eleazar were drawn.  But some think that the original text implies that a double lot was drawn for Eleazar to a single lot for Ithamar.

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:19
segments: Under Aaron their father; all the priests were considered as successors of Aaron, and he is spoken of as their father.

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:20
segments: The rest of the sons of Levi; that is, who were not priests.

entries.title: I Chronicles 24:31
segments:
Over against their brethren; that is, as the original seems to imply, so that course answered to course, there being twenty-four courses of the Levites, corresponding with the twenty-four of the priests. 
 
  The principal fathers over against their younger brethren; so that no preference was given in casting the lots, to one division above another.
